skill_name: Describe a situation when a friend is cheating on a test and what should one should do about it.
workflow: A friend cheating on a test is an ethical dilemma that can be difficult to navigate. On one hand, it may be beneficial for the friend to "get away with it" in the short-term. On the other hand, it is not fair to their peers who are working hard and staying honest. In addition, condoning cheating sets a problematic precedent and encourages similar behavior in the future.
